text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Here ya go!! Big Sis Hishi's special 
stamina bento! Don't go eatin' it before 
lunch, ya hear!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Thanks a bunch, Big Sis Hishi!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You've got a mock race today, right! I'll 
be there to cheer ya on, so give it 
everything you've got!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, hey. Doesn't Big Sis Hishi seem 
extra lively lately?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
I know, right~! It totally pumps me up 
too! I wonder if something great happened?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Passing by the grounds, I saw Hishi Amazon 
engaged in one-on-one races with other 
horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Doryaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right!! That's another showdown in the 
bag for me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...! You're amazing, 
Hishiama-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still, a hero never gives up! I'll train 
up and challenge you to justice once 
more!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! Big Sis Hishi will take 
on any challenger, anytime!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You seem to be in exceptionally high 
spirits, Ama-san.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Brian. You wanna go for a showdown 
too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
As relentless as ever, I see. No matter 
how many times I brush you off, you keep 
snapping back...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. Challenge accepted.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: —Oryaaaaaaaah!! —Haaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon and Narita Brian engaged in a 
fierce dead heat. But gradually, the 
distance between them began to widen...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*... My win.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Aah... you got me. But... *pant*, 
*pant*... ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Aah~~... my blood's boilin'...! How am I 
gonna overtake ya from here?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Ama-san, you seem even more vibrant 
than before.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Yeah, I guess... maybe it's 'cause 
I've come to love showdowns even more.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Tryin' to hold back made me realize just 
how much I truly love 'em.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Plus, all my old memories came floodin' 
back. The fire for showdowns just kept 
burnin' hotter and hotter.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And then I knew for sure: "I'm gonna love 
showdowns for the rest of my life."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And ever since, every day has felt full of 
drive and tension~~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. How like you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this again. Keep your fangs 
sharp.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You bet! Next time, I'm definitely passin' 
ya!
choice_data_list: Why not go for another round right now?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You bet! Next time, I'm definitely passin' 
ya!
choice_data_list: Why not go for another round right now?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Hearin' that makes me happy! Right, 
Brian?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Who knows.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whoa there, don't be so stubborn!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon laughed cheerfully while 
Narita Brian looked away. The two of them 
looked like great comrades-in-arms.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ooh! You up for it, Brian?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, seems you've still got plenty of 
fight left in you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Naturally! Let's go for one more!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon and Narita Brian bounded 
forward into a run once more.
